title.narrative: Support for the defence and implementation of the rights of indigenous peoples in Brazil

description.narrative: The projetc seeks to amplify the defense, promotion, and protection of human rights of indigenous peoples in Brazil. Key outcomes include the maintenance of original and exclusive usufruct rights of lands traditionally occupied by IPs, increased visibility of indigenous thematics as a means to influence and shape public opinion, and diminishing levels of violence committed against IPs due to reporting and systematizations/typification of cases, allowing for more effective law-enforcement.
